activity_screen.rule_ar: نفس فحص النشاط في سلسلة مؤشرات MSCI الإسلامية: الشركات النشطة مباشرة في الخمور أو التبغ (بما فيه القنب لغير الأغراض الطبية والصيدلانية) أو منتجات الخنزير أو الخدمات المالية التقليدية أو الدفاع والأسلحة أو القمار أو الموسيقى أو الفنادق أو السينما أو ترفيه البالغين، أو التي تستمد أكثر من 5% من إيراداتها تراكميًا من هذه الأنشطة (بما فيها دخل الفوائد)، غير متوافقة (منهجية MSCI، القسم 2.1).
activity_screen.rule_en: The same business activity screen as the MSCI Islamic Index Series: companies directly active in, or deriving more than 5% of revenue cumulatively (interest income included, measured against total income) from alcohol, tobacco (including cannabis other than for medical or pharmaceutical use), pork-related products, conventional financial services, defence/weapons, gambling/casino, music, hotels, cinema or adult entertainment (including online dating services) are non-compliant (MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology, May 2025, section 2.1).

basis: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology, May 2025 (MSCI Inc.), section 2.2.2 (threshold table for the M-Series) with sections 2.1 and 2.3 shared with the Index Series. The M-Series is a DISTINCT MSCI index family whose financial ratios are measured against average issuer market capitalisation (the average of month-end market capitalisation over the last 36 months) and whose receivables-and-cash threshold is 49%, not 70%. It ships as its own rule-set file — mirroring MSCI's own two-series structure — because this engine's parameter mechanism (the AAOIFI denominator variant) swaps a denominator only and cannot also change a threshold; the M-Series changes both. Encoded from MSCI's own published methodology document, as issue #169's pin gate requires.
name_ar: منهجية سلسلة مؤشرات MSCI الإسلامية M — مايو 2025
name_en: MSCI Islamic Index M-Series Methodology (May 2025) — MSCI Inc.
notes: The encoded screening thresholds are the methodology's Financial Ratio Thresholds (33.33% / 49%). The Entry Buffer (30% / 46%) governs NEW inclusions; the M-Series threshold table publishes no Exit Buffer. Buffers are index-membership mechanics, recorded per ratio under 'buffers', not screening thresholds.

The denominator is the average of month-end market capitalisation over the last 36 months before the review (where fewer than 36 months of data exist, the available months are used); the data model's avg_market_value_36m, or the engine's derivation of it from a market-cap series, is the corresponding figure.

Sharia-compliant debt and Sharia-compliant instruments are excluded from Total Debt (and from the cash numerator) for a list of markets that includes Egypt (section 2.2); in this engine that exclusion is an input-side adjustment to interest_bearing_debt.

MSCI's 5% business-activity test is measured against Total Income (revenue plus interest income, methodology footnote 4); the data model's total_revenue is the input pipeline's corresponding figure, and interest income sits inside non_compliant_revenue.

In index practice MSCI treats securities with insufficient financial information as non-compliant and exempts Islamic Financial Institutions (Appendix 3); neither index rule is encoded — this engine answers insufficient-data when inputs are missing, and the activity classification is an input.

capital_component.definition_ar: لا تنشر منهجية MSCI تطهيرًا للأرباح الرأسمالية؛ التطهير المنشور فيها خاص بالتوزيعات فقط (عامل تعديل التوزيعات، القسم 2.3)، فلا يُعلن مكوّن رأسمالي.
capital_component.definition_en: MSCI's methodology defines dividend purification only (section 2.3, the dividend adjustment factor); no capital-gains purification is published, so no capital component is declared.

purification.notes_ar: نفس قاعدة سلسلة المؤشرات: عامل تعديل التوزيعات = (إجمالي الدخل − (إيرادات الأنشطة المحظورة + دخل الفوائد)) / إجمالي الدخل (القسم 2.3)، وحصة التوزيع الواجبة التطهير هي 1 − العامل. لا تنشر MSCI قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: The Index Series rule: the dividend adjustment factor is (Total Income - (revenue from prohibited activities + interest income)) / Total Income (methodology section 2.3), and the share of a dividend to purify is 1 - DAF — this rule set's purification ratio. MSCI publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.
